build: as built 2026-10-14: V1.8 printed parts, no audio, USB-C 5 V tether
frame: official MJCF body frames, m; guide geometry mapped from trunk_base qpos0 frame
excluded: Not fitted on the as-built robot: orange V1.9 parts (V1.9 rear pack and head cap replaced by the printed V1.8 ones; speaker_retainer, clip_torso, clip_bracket, clip_head, clip_cap omitted), MAX98357A amplifier, CMS-30204-18SP speaker, no microphone; cables ['amp-lrc', 'amp-bclk', 'amp-din', 'amp-gnd', 'amp-vin', 'spk-plus', 'spk-minus'] and their screws
BNO085 zip ties on the V1.8 shelf (< 0.3 g)
NP-F970 battery: removed by the runner through remove_old_battery_kg (assumption sweep)
Bench tether beyond the robot (USB-C cable, Adafruit 5991 on the bench): not modelled; only the 98 mm of 22 AWG pair drawn on the robot is included. Its drag/pull force is not simulated.
Community printed rings vs official seeed bearings, neck_pitch_ring, neck shims: unchanged or < 1 g
Threaded inserts: none in the guide screw list (all screws are self-tapping TAP)
